releaseLabel: Build 016 — Personal Messaging Center & Company News Feed

branding.primarySlogan: One World. One System. One Intelligent Network.

verification.personalMessagingCenter: 63 pre-populated messages; 21 each for morning, midday, nighttime; date-based rotation
verification.messageStudio: editable message sets; browser-local persistence; role gate is prototype-only
verification.companyNewsFeed: top-of-workspace announcements with quick links and editable announcement studio
verification.securityBoundary: real Global Admin authorization and cross-user sync require backend integration

notes: Build 016 adds a personal encouragement card, three independent 21-message rotations, Message Studio editing and reset, plus a Company News & Announcements feed with hyperlink support. Changes currently persist in localStorage and do not synchronize across users/devices.
